results.title: Urban Legend Mariaban: Kisah Tanah Kalimantan
results.original_title: Urban Legend Mariaban: Kisah Tanah Kalimantan
results.overview: For generations, the residents of a remote village in Kalimantan have upheld a sacred tradition of making offerings to the Mariaban—an ancient ritual believed to guarantee an abundant harvest. But when this deeply rooted custom is broken, the Mariaban's terrifying wrath is unleashed. One by one, lives are violently claimed, and the nights descend into an endless, waking nightmare.

results.title: immortals
results.overview: After the death of his sister, the only way Zoli can financially support his orphaned niece and severely ill nephew is through illegal online challenges.

results.title: Comedy Buddy
results.overview: A rising stand-up comedian who built her career on jokes about her estranged, washed-up father reunites with him to farm new material, only for their uneasy stage collaboration to unearth painful family wounds.

results.title: OJ Unseen: Exploitation of Evil
results.overview: Never-before-seen footage of O.J. Simpson’s prank show reveals a desperate comeback attempt and more unsettling behind-the-scenes truths.

results.title: Irkalla: Gilgamesh's Dream
results.overview: In a burning Baghdad, a homeless boy escapes into myth, seeking to resurrect his parents. As his friend is drawn into violence, Chum-Chum must save him, guided by the shadows of Gilgamesh and the Lamassu in a city that refuses to die.

results.title: The Romantics
results.overview: Liam returns to his hometown of Liverpool to reconnect with the memory of his long-missing sister, but an encounter with an old friend forces him to confront the grief he’s kept buried.

results.title: Falco Mon Amour
results.overview: Falco is the only German-language singer to reach number one in the US billboard chart. This documentary looks back at the life and work of the 1980s Austrian cultural phenomenon who took the world by storm with hits like "Rock Me Amadeus", "Vienna Calling" and "Der Kommissar". With contributions from his last girlfriend, Caroline Perron.

results.title: Displaced
results.overview: A depressed, dysfunctional physicist accidentally sent back in time tries to fix her future by mentoring her troubled 14-year-old self: a whole-ass handful with her own mischievous agenda.

results.overview: Four siblings on the verge of coming-of-age try to build their independent lives without losing the bonds that connect them.

results.title: Almost Forever
results.overview: From the carefree summers of childhood to the turbulent teenage years. Five formative years in a young group of friends in Stockholm, where their bond is put to the test as they navigate their way into adulthood.

results.title: Mermaid Vs. Shark
results.overview: A shark attack survivor transforms into a shark-human hybrid each full moon. He battles flesh-eating mermaids for beach territory while one mermaid and the were-shark develop feelings

results.title: Caju, Meu Amigo
results.overview: United by their love for the same dog, two women scarred by the 2024 flood transform a silent dispute into a journey of encounter, loss, and reconstruction.

results.title: Joana Mallwitz @ Konzerthaus Berlin
results.original_title: Joana Mallwitz und das Konzerthausorchester Berlin
results.overview: The Konzerthausorchester Berlin, conducted by Joana Mallwitz, opens the 2025–2026 season with Maurice Ravel's hypnotic Boléro. This will be followed by Bryce Dessner's Piano Concerto, inspired and performed by pianist Alice Sara Ott. Also on the programme: Anna Meredith's Nautilus, a work brimming with energy, and Ludwig van Beethoven's First Symphony.

results.title: Mem0r1a
results.overview: 1111 arrives on Earth with a mission: to analyze the productivity of the human species. In doing so, it discovers something that wasn't in its database. An inexplicable pattern that rewrites its code.
